edge.title: Replace Muon with AdamW (lr 0.0015, wd 0.1) + 250-step warmup
edge.summary: The hidden block matrices switch from Muon to elementwise AdamW (lr=0.0015, betas=(0.9, 0.95), eps=1e-10, decoupled wd=0.10): no orthogonalization or aspect-ratio scaling, only per-coordinate normalization. A 250-step linear LR warmup is added to every param group (including the aux AdamW groups) and the run is lengthened to 5625 steps, about 1.56x #1. The README flags this Adam baseline as most likely undertuned.

changes.label: Hidden optimizer Muon → AdamW
changes.detail: optimizer2 = AdamW(block 2-D params, lr=block_adamw_lr=0.0015, betas=(0.9, 0.95), eps=1e-10, weight_decay=0.10, fused=True); decoupled decay p *= 1 − lr·wd is 1.5e-4/step at peak (2e-4 for #1's Muon). The Muon class stays defined but is unused.

changes.label: 250-step linear warmup, all groups
changes.detail: Every param group of both optimizers gets group['warmup_steps']=250 and set_hparams uses lr = initial_lr · min(1, (step+1)/250) · eta, so the aux embed/head/1-D groups also warm up despite the comment saying aux groups are left unchanged.

changes.label: train_steps 3600 → 5625
changes.detail: Claimed step equals the scheduled end (single run, 3.279 at 5625).

changes.label: Earlier-draft cosmetic differences
changes.detail: Linear class placed above RMSNorm, x.relu() → F.relu(x), unused Muon renamed (mu→momentum/beta, state key momentum_buffer, range(...)[::world_size]), print0 opens the log file first, param broadcast moved into the init loop. All behavior-neutral.

edge.parent_check: Consistent. Git history shows #2 forked from a same-day draft of train_gpt_simple.py (bf94c68, train_steps=3550) that is behaviorally identical to #1 apart from train_steps, which explains the cosmetic diff lines.
edge.noise: Linear/RMSNorm reordering, F.relu, renames inside the now-unused Muon class, print0 restructure, moved dist.broadcast, whitespace.

techniques.note: AdamW lr 0.0015, betas (0.9,0.95), eps 1e-10, wd 0.10 on all 72 block 2-D weights
linear warmup over 250 steps, applied to every group incl. aux AdamW
as #1: all 'proj' params (incl. LM head) zeroed

hparams.schedule.kind: linear warmup, stable, then linear decay to 0
hparams.init.hidden_std: torch default nn.Linear U(±1/sqrt(fan_in)), std ≈ 0.0208 (q, k, v, mlp.fc)
hparams.init.proj: zero (attn.proj, mlp.proj and LM head weights)
hparams.init.bias: torch default U(±1/sqrt(fan_in)) for q/k/v/fc; proj biases zero

mechanisms.name: AdamW on hidden matrices
mechanisms.explain: Each hidden weight takes the bias-corrected Adam step m̂/(√v̂ + 1e-10) with betas (0.9, 0.95), a per-coordinate normalization instead of Muon's per-matrix orthogonalization, plus decoupled decay p *= 1 − lr·0.1. There is no spectral or aspect-ratio scaling, so the update geometry is elementwise (sign-like) rather than spectral.

mechanisms.name: Linear LR warmup
mechanisms.explain: set_hparams multiplies each group's lr by min(1, (step+1)/warmup_steps) with warmup_steps=250, on top of the stable/decay factor. All groups (hidden AdamW and aux AdamW) ramp from 1/250 of their peak lr to full lr over the first 250 steps.

caveats: Single run (3.279, n=1) recorded before the significance rule; the README itself says it is most likely undertuned. The warmup also hits the aux AdamW groups, contrary to the in-code comment. The old Muon class remains as dead code.
